entries.title: JPL Horizons ephemeris source
entries.description: Reference for preparing dated solar-system state vectors with explicit target, origin, frame, time scale and units before rendering.
entries.provenance: NASA JPL Solar System Dynamics Horizons manual, checked 2026-10-14; no downloaded ephemeris is bundled by this record.
limitations: No Horizons connector or parser is installed in the production agent pipeline.
Exact request, returned metadata, units, frame, source snapshot and applicable usage terms must accompany prepared samples.

entries.title: USGS elevation-data preparation source
entries.description: Reference for selecting and preparing a bounded elevation grid while preserving projection, datum, resolution, units and missing data.
entries.provenance: USGS DEM metadata documentation and glossary, checked 2026-10-14; this record does not bundle or fetch a dataset.
limitations: No GeoTIFF reader, GIS reprojection or elevation downloader is installed in scene or agent tools.
Product coverage and resolution vary; preserve each selected product metadata and usage terms.
